'''ISF-E4 Eliminator Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] droids of this model were used by the [[Shadow Fist]] in their trap set for the [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ISF-E4 Eliminator Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
